Fresh searches on Profesia, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs and Upwork produced no new independently verifiable target-profile delta in this run. Reddit results were stale or US-only. Facebook again produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Index crawl-age vs publish-age guard
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Track search-engine crawl freshness separately from the job's real published/updated date. A page crawled today can still describe an old or evergreen vacancy; separating these signals prevents false <24h priority and reduces stale promotions.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Reverification delta log
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: When an existing LIVE job is reopened, store only what actually changed (active state, pay, location, language, schedule, deadline, source URL). This makes repeated hourly audits cheaper and highlights material changes without touching stable IDs or duplicating jobs.
